headline: School Committee to discuss Interim Chief Financial Officer Contract, Superintendent evaluation, and FY2027 budget plans.
summary: The meeting covers personnel matters in executive session, including the Interim Chief Financial Officer Contract and Superintendent Annual Evaluation. In open session, the committee will review purchase orders, homeschool requests, a fundraiser, personnel actions, and several financial and facility items including the FY2027 budget plan and the Curtis Corner high school building project.
items: Executive session on Interim Chief Financial Officer Contract (RIGL 42-46-5(a)(1))
Executive session on Superintendent Annual Evaluation (RIGL 42-46-5(a)(1))
Disclosure of votes taken in executive session
Approval of purchase orders over $10,350 to various vendors including Renaissance Learning, ECA Educational Services Inc, Rhode Island Interlocal Risk Management Trust, Cox Communications, and others
Approval of homeschool requests for SY 2026-2027 (Student 25 through Student 50)
Approval of fundraiser: SKHS Football Discount Card with Adrenaline Fundraising
Personnel actions including leaves of absence, retirement, resignations, and new appointments (for information only)
Welcome new faculty, staff and administration
Memo from Rhode Island Department of Education on CTE Tuition Calculations for SY 2026-2027
Discussion/Action: Approval of Interim Chief Financial Officer Contract
Discussion/Action: Fiscal Year 2027 Recommended Plan to Meet State Financial Reporting Requirements
Discussion/Action: Fiscal Year 2027 Budget to Actual Monthly Report memo from Anthony Ferrucci, Financial Consultant (8/21/2026)
Discussion/Action: Fiscal Year 2026 District End of Year Revenue, Expenses and Fund Balance
Discussion/Action: Capital Improvement Plan (CIP) Update for Fiscal Year 2027 and impact on Five Year Plan
Discussion: School Building Committee status update on new South Kingstown High School and Athletic Field/Stadium Complex at Curtis Corner
